title: Mollification of an integrable function by a smooth compactly supported kernel is Lipschitz with constant proportional to its L¹ norm
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n with Lebesgue measure) be smooth (ContDiff ℝ ⊤) with compact support. Then there is a constant L ≥ 0 such that for every set S ⊆ ℝⁿ, every v : ℝⁿ → ℝ Lebesgue integrable on S, and all x, x' ∈ ℝⁿ: |∫_S v(y)φ(x − y) dy − ∫_S v(y)φ(x' − y) dy| ≤ L·(∫_S |v(y)| dy)·dist(x, x').
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Euclid n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ (S : Set (Euclid n)) (v : Euclid n → ℝ), IntegrableOn v S → ∀ x x' : Euclid n, |(∫ y in S, v y * φ (x - y)) - ∫ y in S, v y * φ (x' - y)| ≤ L * (∫ y in S, |v y|) * dist x x'
